text: The Ba River Flood Mitigation Dredging initiative is a recurring programmatic measure undertaken by the Government of Fiji to mitigate severe flooding in the Ba River catchment area. This initiative involves targeted dredging interventions to increase the river's discharge capacity, thereby safeguarding Ba Town and surrounding communities from riverine and coastal flooding. The most recent dredging phase, conducted from August 2024 to June 2025 by Hall Contracting, removed over 300,000 m3 of sediment from a critically silted 3.6 km stretch of the river mouth, aligning with Fiji's National Flood Management Strategy and broader flood mitigation efforts.
